description: Arx Bot Control for one hosted website or site network subsite (serviceId): get (default) shows the policy (with the site's IP allow and block lists), web firewall matches (waf), the effective rule per category (search, services, social, ai, seo, tools, fake, automation, suspicious, human), the catalog with tags, whether it is active on the web server, and 7-day stats. set (confirm): preset off|standard|strict|custom, mode on|log (log = watch only, nothing is enforced), for custom: rules and sensitive (category -> {action allow|log|throttle|limit|challenge|block, rate per second, burst}), paths (sensitive path prefixes such as /wp-login.php). Search engines can never be challenged or blocked. set_ips (confirm): ipAllow and ipBlock, lists of IP addresses or CIDR ranges (at most 100 each, ranges no wider than /16 IPv4 or /32 IPv6); allowed addresses skip every bot rule, blocked addresses get 403 on this site even while Bot Control only watches. The lists replace the saved ones. set_limits (confirm): concurrency {enabled, crawlers, search, perIp}, caps on requests in progress on this site, enforced by the web server while Bot Control is on: crawlers = AI, social and SEO bots together across all their addresses (default 4), search = search engines together (default 8, answered 429 with Retry-After so they slow down, never blocked), perIp = any one address (default 5); 0 turns one cap off, enabled false turns all off. Static files, our own addresses and allow-listed addresses never count. Watch mode only logs. policy.concurrency in get shows the saved caps.

action.description: get is default. set, set_ips and set_limits need confirm.

concurrency.description: set_limits: caps on requests in progress on this site.

crawlers.description: AI, social and SEO bots together, requests in progress (default 4, 0 = no cap).

enabled.description: false turns every cap off for the site.

search.description: Search engines together (default 8); over it they get 429 with Retry-After, never a block.

ipAllow.description: set_ips: addresses or CIDR ranges always let through (replaces the list).

ipBlock.description: set_ips: addresses or CIDR ranges always blocked on this site (replaces the list).

mode.description: log = watch only: counts what would happen, enforces nothing.

rules.description: custom: category -> rule (search, services, social, ai, seo, tools, fake, automation, suspicious, human).

sensitive.description: custom: rules that apply on sensitive paths only.
